jobs.name: gpu-info
jobs.command: nvidia-smi | tee gpu-info.txt && nvcc --version | tee -a gpu-info.txt

jobs.name: deps
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; python3 -m pip install --quiet numpy 2>&1 | tee deps.log && python3 -c 'import numpy; print("numpy", numpy.__version__)' 2>&1 | tee -a deps.log

jobs.name: prebuild
jobs.command: set -o pipefail; DSHA=$(find experimental/duck_cuda -type f -not -path '*/build-remote/*' -print0 | sort -z | xargs -0 sha256sum | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1); echo "source sha $DSHA" | tee build.log; (cd experimental/duck_cuda && ./build_remote.sh) 2>&1 | tee -a build.log && mkdir -p /opt/duck/prebuilt/$DSHA && cp -f experimental/duck_cuda/build-remote/libduck_cuda*.so /opt/duck/prebuilt/$DSHA/ && echo $DSHA > /opt/duck/prebuilt/CURRENT && printf %s "$DSHA" | tee prebuilt-sha.txt && ls -la /opt/duck/prebuilt/$DSHA | tee -a build.log
